desc: Knock your to-do list out of the park with the Outfield everyday carry knife. This folder opens in a snap thanks to assisted opening and a flipper. Use the drop point blade to complete all your cutting tasks, from breaking down cardboard boxes to slicing through fruit for a snack. Carry it on your adventures using the deep-carry pocket clip. Not only can you depend on a lifetime of reliable performance, but it's available at an unbeatable price. Make your next tool a home run with the Outfield.
